package.description: Managed Service Accounts are a useful new feature introduced in Server 2008 R2 but they can only be created and managed with Powershell, so this tool was created to provide an intuitive GUI that will let you create, edit, and install them

en-US.description: Managed Service Accounts are a useful new feature introduced in Server 2008 R2 but they can only be created and managed with Powershell, so this tool was created to provide an intuitive GUI that will let you create, edit, and install them
en-US.longDescription:
Managed Service Accounts are a great new feature that was added to Windows Server 2008 R2 and Windows 7, but up until now the only way to create and configure them has been via Powershell cmdlets (requiring at least 3 separate commands to be run, one of which has to be run locally on the computer that will use the MSA). So we created this tool to provide a free, easy to use GUI application for working with MSAs.

Features
- Simple and intuitive graphical user interface (no LDAP or powershell knowledge required)
- Quick and easy to create and assign new MSAs, as well as removing old MSAs
- Create and configure Group Managed Service Accounts introduced in Windows Server 2012
- Install and uninstall MSAs on remote computers
- Configure properties of existing MSAs, including the ability to disable them, set their expiry date, add them to groups, modify SPNs, and more
- Uses native Windows APIs and LDAP operations where possible instead of Powershell for improved performance
- Multi-domain friendly, simply enter the domain name (and credentials) for any domain you want to manage MSAs on
en-US.name: Managed Service Accounts GUI

zh-CN.description: 托管服务账户是 Server 2008 R2 引入的一项实用新功能，但这些账户只能通过 Powershell 创建和管理。为此，我们开发了这款工具，旨在提供一个直观的图形界面，方便您创建、编辑和安装托管服务账户。
zh-CN.longDescription:
托管服务账户（MSA）是 Windows Server 2008 R2 和 Windows 7 引入的优秀新功能，但此前只能通过 PowerShell 命令（需至少运行 3 条独立命令，其中一条必须在使用 MSA 的计算机本地执行）来创建和配置。为此我们开发了这款工具，提供免费易用的图形界面应用程序来管理 MSA。

功能特性
- 简洁直观的图形界面（无需掌握 LDAP 或 PowerShell 知识）
- 快速创建/分配新 MSA，轻松移除旧 MSA
- 支持创建和配置 Windows Server 2012 引入的组托管服务账户
- 可在远程计算机上安装/卸载 MSA
- 配置现有 MSA 属性，包括禁用账户、设置过期时间、添加至组、修改 SPN 等
- 优先使用原生 Windows API 和 LDAP 操作替代 PowerShell 以提升性能
- 多域支持，只需输入目标域名（及凭证）即可管理任意域的 MSA
